coreMemory.english: v. to give information, narrate, or recognize a difference
coreMemory.structure: tell someone something /ˈtɛl ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（告诉某人某事）；tell someone to do something /ˈtɛl ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（叫某人做某事）；tell the truth /ˈtɛl ðə ˈtruːθ/（说实话）；tell a story /ˈtɛl ə ˈstɔːriː/（讲故事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to tell → ✅ can tell；❌ to telling → ✅ to tell

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。
